name: tools.list
description: List all available tools grouped by category. Use tools.search for full schemas.

name: tools.search
description: Search deferred tools by describing the capability you need. Returns the most relevant full schemas so they can be called in subsequent rounds. Use one broad natural-language query.

query.description: Broad natural-language description of the capability you need.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 3 and is capped at 20.
